lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity, roughly circular white pixel clusters is visible posterior to the branchial region, with a primary cluster of five large spots forming a trapezoidal arrangement mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, most notably in the transition zone immediately behind the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the dorsal-lateral interface, defined by a high-contrast luminance gradient with light-saturated pixels on the upper edge and a shadowed trough below.

other_distinctive_markers: The leading edge and dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin exhibit a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots that decrease in size toward the posterior margin.
